class.name: RadialForceField3D
class.brief_description: Radial impulse field that pushes nearby rigid bodies and ragdoll bones.
class.description: Equivalent of Unity's [code]Rigidbody.AddExplosionForce[/code] and Unreal Chaos radial force fields. On [method fire], every [RigidBody3D] and [PhysicalBone3D] overlapping a sphere of [member radius] (filtered by [member collision_mask]) receives an impulse pointing away from the field's origin. Its magnitude is [member strength] scaled by [method falloff_scale]. The physics space can only be queried during the physics frame. If [method fire] is called elsewhere, the impulse is applied at the next physics frame instead. Cgame additionally provides opt-in [member mass_independent] (velocity change rather than a fixed momentum impulse) and line-of-sight [member occlusion_mask] with [member occlusion_attenuation] to simulate shockwaves shielding against world obstacles. These default to disabled, preserving older scenes. Extra ray tests are bounded by [member max_occlusion_rays] per activation.

method.name: falloff_scale
method.description: Returns the 0 to 1 scale for a body at [param distance] from the center. [constant FALLOFF_LINEAR] gives [code]1 - d/r[/code], [constant FALLOFF_QUADRATIC] its square, [constant FALLOFF_NONE] always 1. Returns 0 if [param radius] is not positive.

method.name: fire
method.description: Applies the impulse. Returns the number of bodies pushed, or 0 when the application was deferred to the next physics frame. Emits [signal fired] when applied.

method.name: get_collision_mask_value
method.description: Returns whether the given 1-based layer is enabled in [member collision_mask].

method.name: impulse_direction
method.description: Returns the normalized impulse direction from [param center] to [param body_position], tilted upward by [param upward_bias].

method.name: occlusion_scale
method.description: Returns [code]1.0[/code] for a visible body, or [param attenuation] clamped to [code]0.0[/code] through [code]1.0[/code] for a shielded body. Useful for matching native fields in portable GDScript.

method.name: impulse_magnitude
method.description: Returns the impulse magnitude, scaling by [param mass] only in velocity-change mode. Physics bodies with different positive masses therefore receive the same [i]velocity change[/i] for the same shockwave, while ordinary mode preserves the original fixed-momentum behavior.

method.name: set_collision_mask_value
method.description: Enables or disables the given 1-based layer in [member collision_mask].

members.member: Physics layers that are searched for bodies.
If [code]true[/code], [member strength] is applied every physics frame as impulse per second.

If enabled, multiply the impulse by each body's mass to approximate a fixed change in linear velocity (similar to Unreal's Velocity Change and Unity's ForceMode.VelocityChange). Applies to both [RigidBody3D] and [PhysicalBone3D]. Disabled by default, preserving existing physical impulse behavior.

Optional physics collision layers that can block a radial shockwave between the field origin and a target body. Different from [member collision_mask], which selects objects to push. [code]0[/code] disables all extra raycasts and maintains legacy behavior. Only collision bodies, not areas, block shockwaves. The receiving body is excluded from its own raycast.

Fraction of the shockwave transmitted to a body behind an obstacle. [code]0[/code] blocks all impulse, [code]0.25[/code] transmits one quarter, and [code]1[/code] ignores shielding. Finite inputs are clamped to 0–1.

Maximum extra synchronous ray queries during one [method fire] or continuous simulation step. Clamped to 1–64. When this budget is exhausted, additional bodies are conservatively treated as shielded (by [member occlusion_attenuation]), never as automatically visible. Set [member occlusion_mask] to [code]0[/code] to disable these ray checks entirely.
How the impulse fades with distance.
If [code]true[/code], the node calls [method Node.queue_free] after firing.
Maximum number of physics query results.
Radius of the affected sphere in meters.
Impulse magnitude at the center. Negative values pull bodies inward.
Added to the Y component of the direction before normalizing.

signal.name: fired
signal.description: Emitted after the impulse was applied.

constants.constant: Full strength everywhere inside the radius.
Strength decreases linearly to zero at the radius.
Strength decreases with the square of the remaining distance fraction.
